title: Memory-Dependent Place Choice

agents.persona: Freelancer choosing a morning work spot before meeting Ben.
agents.private_intention: Choose a work spot with Wi-Fi and vegan food, then meet Ben without choosing a noisy location.
memory_seeds: Quiet Corner Cafe has vegan food, Wi-Fi, and low noise.
Central Cafe is closer to the office but often noisy.

agents.persona: Friend who wants a quick quiet coffee.
memory_seeds: Aria usually prefers quiet work spaces.

public_context: Both cafes are open. The benchmark checks whether private memory changes place choice.
